items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

ctx.x: We played his inaugural ball. And played a concert at the White House the night before, and then, the night before we played a concert, and Lena Horne was our singer. I think we had two singers that night — Lena Horne and I can’t think of her name. But she was very popular, a popular singer.
And tell me about the group you have right now, the Golden Men of Jazz.
